title: OSI COTP: Handle TSDU fragmentation in both directions
description:
Connection Oriented Transport Protocol class 0, generally carried over
TPKT, uses fragment_add_seq_next, which needs a unique frag id/sequence
number for each fragment in order to properly retrieve reassembly on
later passes than the first sequential pass in the case where more than
one reassembly is completed in the same frame. We have to store some of
that information in file scoped data so that when dissecting the frames
in an unspecified order on subsequent passes the correct frag id is
used.

The frag ids **must** be tracked separately for both directions of a
conversation, which was not happening previously. Move the fragment id
handling from global variables to per-flow conversation data variables.

Fix #21350

AI-Assisted: no
